parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the device license authorization. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: IotId
parameters.description:
The device ID of the device to query.

You can invoke the [QueryDevice](~~69905~~) operation to query the **IotId** of all devices under a specified product.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- For new public instances or Enterprise instances, the instance has an ID value. You must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the invocation failed.
- For legacy public instances, the instance has no ID value. You do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: LicenseCode
parameters.description: The license type (audio and video specification). Valid values: **480P** and **720P**.

parameters.name: PageId
parameters.description: The page number for paging query.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of records per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs.

You can view the information about all products in the current instance in the IoT Platform console or by invoking the [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) operation.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the device license authorization. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
